name: What is the probate process for selling an inherited home in Florida?

mainEntity.name: What is the probate process for selling an inherited home in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Florida, selling an inherited home typically requires navigating the probate process to legally transfer the title to the beneficiaries or the estate's personal representative. The property cannot be fully sold until the court authorizes the sale, which can take several months depending on the complexity of the estate. Understanding the full probate timeline and requirements is critical. Kelby Contreras can work closely with your probate attorney to coordinate the real estate marketing and sale efforts once legal clearances are obtained, ensuring a smooth transition once the court order is in place.
acceptedAnswer.description: Selling an inherited home in Florida involves probate to legally transfer title, and the sale can only proceed with court authorization. Your agent can coordinate with your attorney.
